summary: CO-5A read-only rebaseline completed on AlembicCore HEAD 0f7af28b67b7e0d0e847b4d83b3195bf75259f00 with no source edits and a clean post-check worktree. Key findings: (1) the original Design premise for service/project-intelligence/AnalysisPhaseRunners.ts is stale: the file is 1,075 LOC, not a 35k LOC giant. It is already an extracted service-layer runner used by ProjectIntelligenceRunner re-exports and PanoramaScanner dynamic import; no cross-repo production consumer imports AnalysisPhaseRunners directly. A broad language-split is not justified by current evidence. (2) KnowledgeService still has six deprecated compatibility aliases: submit->get, approve->publish, autoApprove->get, reject->deprecate, toDraft->reactivate, fastTrack->publish. approve/reject have production consumers in Alembic lib/governance/gateway/GatewayActionRegistry.ts; all six are also covered by Core/consumer tests. Alias deletion requires consumer migration or explicit compatibility decision. (3) Core AST/discovery/analysis public exports remain transitional/test-backed. AlembicPlugin tests still import @alembic/core/core/discovery, @alembic/core/core/analysis, @alembic/core/core/ast/lang-* and retired @alembic/core/project-intelligence surfaces; AlembicAgent has no live project-intelligence import. Core internal users include project-context extractors, GuardCheckEngine, AnalysisPhaseRunners, PanoramaScanner, and ASTChunker. Do not delete these routes in CO-5B without replacement test fixtures and consumer migration. (4) quality/bootstrap are still public service facades with production consumers in Alembic and AlembicPlugin; panorama is already not a package export and is guarded by PublicProjectIntelligenceEntrypoints.test.ts. (5) RecipeContext/ProjectContext/vector test baselines are materially higher than the earlier inventory: RecipeContext 2 files / 27 tests, ProjectContext 10 files / 52 tests, Vector 4 files / 149 tests. Existing tests cover internal behavior, but unused RecipeContext kinds must not be reclassified as externally wired without a controller/user decision. Recommended CO-5B: consumer-safe test/public-surface cleanup, especially migrating AlembicPlugin residual project-intelligence and AST/discovery test imports to supported test fixtures before shrinking exports. Recommended CO-5C: production compatibility/facade cleanup, first migrating Alembic Gateway approve/reject to publish/deprecate and then deciding whether to remove or retain KnowledgeService aliases; keep quality/bootstrap unless their production consumers are migrated.
